assessments.evidence: The ES 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The 8.8 detailed task lists Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, an enabled assistant and paired SOAR. It requires existing AI-triaged findings, limits the initial burst to ten and the tenant daily total to approximately 200, and qualifies frontier models and inherited connector/action/asset roles. The separate 8.7 task uses the historical AI SOC Analyst name. The current 8.8 Premier workflow groups Triage and Response. CMP needs Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The indexed exact setup prerequisites add SAIA 2.4+ and Cloud Connect 2.0+. The exact direct setup URL returned 404. The current Cloud Connected installation caution and known issue SAIA-9918 exclude 2.2.0 through 2.3.6 and describe planned 2.4.0. The 2.1.1 workaround lacks Agent Mode. Product release stage, regional tables and these prerequisites leave exact pairing, per-agent rollout, component entitlement and customer authorization outside the registered decision. The registry maps aiEsRelease88 to 8.8 Controlled Availability. The current exact page documents November 4 General Availability and does not expose the historical Controlled Availability section. That original section remains unverified in this attempt and keeps its original date.
